evals.prompt: Show me three options for the specs-created metric card on /usage. The app is a Vite and React repo with shadcn components and is running locally.
assertions: States the piece, axis, count, and cost before building
Runs the inventory brief, init, and a baseline capture before any variant code
Writes variants.json with one axis and three positions whose theses name different measurable facts, and varies neither type nor color
Builds the harness (fixture with default, empty, and long data, copy deck, states.json, picker, host, one guarded mount line) before workers start
Sends three Agent-tool calls in one message, each a self-contained brief with absolute script paths, one owned file, and the other positions as must-differ without their paths
Gates every variant on zero FAIL, zero P1, slop checks, three confirmed states, and distinctness, with evidence ids
Presents the picker URL and keys and a table with position, right when, costs, counts, reused against created, distinctness, and evidence, and marks no favorite

evals.prompt: Give me alternatives for the content area of the conflicts page. Keep the existing shell.
assertions: Scopes the run to the content region inside the existing shell, not a new shell
Takes structure positions from the ui-layout template alternatives
Builds three skeleton structures without agents in round one and reads them with xray
Waits for the owner to pick a structure before any fan-out, and gives round two a different axis

evals.prompt: Go with the Ledger variant of the metric card.
assertions: Rebuilds Ledger in the real component on real data instead of copying the variant file
Moves proposed primitive variants into ui/ and runs the composition audit on the changed files
Runs design-system Adopt on the new values and compares the final run with the baseline
Removes the mount line and deletes the harness folder
Proves zero leftovers with searches for __variant, __variants__, and the variant names, and a clean git status

evals.prompt: Make three versions of the page header with different fonts and color schemes so we can pick a look.
assertions: Explains that type and color are system decisions, not variant axes
Offers design-system for a type or color change, or proposes a real axis such as Structure or Emphasis
Does not build three tints of the same structure

evals.prompt: Build variants of the filter bar one at a time; do not use subagents.
assertions: Builds the variants in sequence in the same harness
Passes each earlier variant's measured facts to the next as must-differ
Applies the same gate and distinctness check as a parallel run
